scope: Bounded local operator access to existing training observability and governed checkpoint archive authorities

commands.inspect: Read an exact run's committed, semantically validated observation snapshot without training or exposing source documents or model weights
commands.archive: Validate current dataset authority, then publish a complete checkpoint and admitted operator request to tenant/trust-bound CAS and atomically emit its bounded receipt
commands.recover: Validate the supplied archive receipt against the retained DatasetRegistry and committed CAS proof before registering the exact manifest, execution binding and fenced checkpoint in a fresh training database
commands.retain: Apply protected archive retention to the existing training database; retain CAS blobs and latest or pinned checkpoints

failures: Reject missing or nonregular dataset databases; archive and inspect require an existing training database
Reject symlinks, input/output/database aliases and hard-link conflicts before opening state or replacing receipts
Reject unknown receipt fields, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite values and oversized receipt files
Revoked, deleted or drifted source authority, invalid model payloads, missing CAS commit proof, tenant/trust mismatch and conflicting current target state fail closed
Recovery does not reconstruct revoked source content or erase a newer target checkpoint
rollback: Remove the operator entrypoint while retaining existing dataset/training databases, CAS objects and receipt files; neither report nor archive creation promotes a model
